'skinparam ParticipantPadding' is ignored: use a style instead
{"error": "Maturity date cannot be earlier than today"}
SELECT * FROM trades WHERE trade_id = :id FOR UPDATE
[Case A: No Existing Record Found (New Trade)]
[Case B: Lower Version Received (Incoming Version < Existing Version)]
{"error": "Lower version rejected. Current version is higher."}
[Case C: Same Version Received (Incoming Version == Existing Version)]
UPDATE trades SET ... WHERE trade_id = :id AND version = :v
[Case D: Higher Version Received (Incoming Version > Existing Version)]
Update trade to new version & attributes
UPDATE trades SET version = :new_v, ... WHERE trade_id = :id
